domains.name: The Nature and Concept of Management
Introduction to the Different Functional Areas of Management
Managing a Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) Legal Foundations on Business Enterprise

standards.text: Learners demonstrate an understanding of fundamental concepts, theories, and function of management including the role of business within their environments and the impact of external factors on organizational success for the promotion of inclusive practices and gender equality.
The learners design an organizational structure with specified roles and responsibilities.

Learners demonstrate understanding of control concepts and techniques and their relationship to management functions among small and medium enterprises while valuing social responsibility and sustainable business practices.
The learners prepare any advocacy campaign material for an existing business, promoting ethical business practices integrating United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

competencies.text: Discuss the fundamental concepts and theories of management
Analyze the firm’s environment using SWOT and PESTEL analyses
Analyze the different functions of management
Explain the importance of integrating inclusivity and gender equality in the methods of staffing
Differentiate between the roles, characteristics, and functions of a leader and a manager in various organizational contexts
Analyze the impact of communication, motivation, change management, and cultural diversity on leadership
Apply management control in an organization
Analyze the scope and significance of the different functional areas of management in relation to controlling
Discuss the legal foundations in managing business enterprises
Discuss the business ethics concepts as well as the responsibilities and accountabilities of entrepreneurs toward stakeholders
Analyze issues and implications of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) to small and business enterprises
